subject: 86 Swan Street Cannabis Delivery Proposal
overview: Kindly Delivery held a community outreach meeting detailing its proposal to operate an adult-use cannabis delivery business at 86 Swan Street. The presentation reviewed security measures, delivery logistics, local hiring goals, and projected municipal revenues.

items.title: Kindly Delivery Community Outreach Presentation
items.summary: Lisa Mariello presented Kindly Delivery's proposal for a cannabis delivery operator facility at 86 Swan Street, outlining security protocols, delivery operations, diversity hiring commitments, and projected tax payments to the city.
